description: Generates a canonical, editable ArenaScript from an idea. Deterministic: the signals named in the idea (RSI overbought/oversold, EMA crossover, Donchian breakout, Bollinger, MACD, VWAP, volume, ADX, trend; short/sell → short_entry section) become the entry conditions; idea_used says what was recognised. Exits, size and params come from the style. asset and timeframe are limited to an allowlist. Styles: balanced, trend, breakout, momentum, mean_reversion, scalping.

asset.description: Asset, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL, BNB.
asset.title: Asset

idea.description: Strategy idea in free text (2,000 characters max).
idea.title: Idea

name: generate_arenascript_strategy
